kind: Solvable exponents and zero-threshold mass collapse
scope: The positive solvable exponents form an upper interval. At zero threshold, any genuine exact solutions along exponents tending to zero have scalar and total mass tending to zero, with uniform exponential and unnormalized-potential collapse. Neither existence for arbitrary zero-threshold data nor normalized-potential convergence is concluded.

direct_analytic_review_obligations.compact-connected-setting: h is Hermitian on a connected compact manifold; genuine potentials have finite real supremum and are finite almost everywhere.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.fixed-data: The same nonzero nonnegative L1 density f is used for every exponent; no moving measure is substituted.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.existence-equivalence: An exact solution is a subsolution, while the retained greatest-solution theorem makes a genuine subsolution sufficient.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.finite-positive-exact-mass: For each solution, exp(lambda u)f has finite positive integral, using its finite supremum and its volume-null pole set.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.negative-shift: Subtracting max(0,sup u) gives s<=0 and exp(lambda0 s)<=exp(lambda0 u).
direct_analytic_review_obligations.constant-invariance: Subtracting a finite constant preserves genuineness, admissibility and the extended Monge-Ampere measure.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.exponent-direction: For s<=0 and lambda>=lambda0, exp(lambda s)<=exp(lambda0 s); the inequality direction is upward solvability.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.upper-set-interval: For any lambda above the nonempty set infimum, a smaller admitted exponent exists. A positive endpoint may or may not be included; zero is never included.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.positive-threshold: The retained positive-threshold corollary supplies every positive exponent; no converse is claimed.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.conditional-zero-sequence: Collapse assumes exact solutions along exponents decreasing to zero. It does not supply them for an arbitrary zero-threshold density.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.normalized-potential: v_j=u_j-sup u_j remains genuine h-psh with supremum zero.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.fixed-nonpluripolar-measure: The fixed finite measure f dV does not charge pluripolar sets, permitting the retained normalized exponential damping lemma.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.L1-damping: g_j=exp(lambda_j v_j)f converges to f in L1 without potential convergence or a positive lower-mass hypothesis.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.nonzero-damped-density: A genuine quasi-psh potential is finite dV-almost everywhere, so g_j is nonzero and integrable.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.threshold-comparison: The exact equality MA(v_j)=c_j g_j dV gives 0<c_j<=b_h(g_j) by maximal subsolution characterization, with no equality of c_j and b_h(g_j) asserted.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.upper-semicontinuity: The retained L1 upper semicontinuity theorem gives limsup c_j<=b_h(f)=0; positivity completes the limit.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.total-variation: A positive finite measure has total variation equal to its mass. The mass bound c_j integral f tends to zero, and constant invariance gives the same normalized mass.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.logarithmic-collapse: log c_j=lambda_j sup u_j tends to minus infinity; no rate for c_j is deduced.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.uniform-exponential: At poles the exponential is zero and everywhere it is between zero and c_j, giving uniform convergence.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.uniform-upper-collapse: Eventually lambda_j<1 and log c_j<0; sup u_j<=log c_j tends to minus infinity. This is distinct from normalized-potential convergence.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.full-parameter-consequence: The statement along all decreasing sequences gives the full lambda-downarrow0 conclusion for any solution family when existence holds for all positive exponents.
direct_analytic_review_obligations.S03-application-boundary: The tailored 521 family supplies the existence premise. Its fixed barrier mass CV0 and collapsing exact masses are compatible, since potential order does not imply total-mass order for nonclosed backgrounds.
